title.zh: 请升级至 v0.1.10（静默安装受阻时请手动覆盖）
title.en: Please update to v0.1.10 (install manually if silent update stalls)

body.zh: v0.1.9 存在静默自更新超时失败、Shizuku 误报未授权、设置页偶发 502 及顶部定时任务条残留等问题，已在 v0.1.10 修复。从旧版更新时建议直接前往 GitHub Releases 下载新版 APK 手动覆盖安装，或硬等静默安装超时后在自动弹出的系统安装器中手动点击安装（数据与会话完整保留）。
body.en: v0.1.9 has regressions causing silent self-update timeouts, false Shizuku unauthorized status, occasional HTTP 502 errors in Settings, and lingering timer badges, fixed in v0.1.10. To update from v0.1.9, please download the new APK from GitHub Releases and overwrite-install manually, or wait out the silent-install timeout and tap Install in the system prompt (all data and sessions are preserved).
